-- name: ListAccountSpending
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS spent,
        count(*) AS line_count
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.account_id
)

SELECT
    a.id,
    a.name,
    a.email,
    coalesce(t.spent, 0) AS spent,
    t.line_count,
    t.account_id
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.account_id = a.id
WHERE a.closed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY spent DESC
LIMIT @limit OFFSET @offset;
